facts.text: Under the Stockton Promise, first- or second-year New Jersey students with an adjusted gross income of $0 to $65,000 have 100% of the gap between financial aid and tuition and fees covered.

sources.title: The Stockton Promise - Office of Financial Aid | Stockton University
sources.quote: The Stockton Promise covers 100% of the gap between federal, state* and institutional financial aid funds (grants & scholarships) and the cost of tuition & fees for qualifying students who are in their first or second year of study

sources.title: The Stockton Promise - Office of Financial Aid | Stockton University
sources.quote: Have an adjusted gross income (AGI) of $0 - $65,000 per year AND a Student Aid Index (SAI) of 15,000 or less, as per the FAFSA
